# TitanCharts Enterprise Documentation

> TitanCharts Enterprise is a high-performance financial charting library for React. It ships two npm packages: `@titancharts/react` (charts, indicators, drawing tools, trading overlays, Hyperliquid portfolio overlay) and `@titancharts/data` (unified DataFeed for crypto exchanges, Polymarket prediction markets, and custom sources).

Every page below is also fetchable as raw markdown by appending `.md` to its URL — agents should prefer the `.md` form. The list is hierarchical: top-level items are the main surface areas, nested items are sub-topics.

- [TitanChart Documentation](https://percept.one/docs/README.md): Professional charting library for financial applications with React support.

## Getting Started

- [Overview](https://percept.one/docs/getting-started/README.md): Set up TitanCharts and understand the fundamentals.
- [Quick Start](https://percept.one/docs/quickstart.md): Get a live chart running in under 2 minutes.
- [How It Works](https://percept.one/docs/getting-started/how-it-works.md): Understand TitanChart's data flow, integration points, and architecture.
- [Installation](https://percept.one/docs/getting-started/installation.md): Install TitanCharts and ship your first chart.
- [Core Concepts](https://percept.one/docs/getting-started/core-concepts.md): Learn the building blocks behind charts, series, and viewports.

## Features

- [Overview](https://percept.one/docs/features/README.md): Core charting features including indicators, drawings, and theming.
- [Data Loading](https://percept.one/docs/features/data-loading.md): Load, update, and manage chart data effectively.
- [Indicators](https://percept.one/docs/features/indicators/README.md): Use built-in indicators and build your own.
  - [Tier 1: Indicator Builder](https://percept.one/docs/features/indicators/tier1-builder.md): Build indicators in ~20 lines with createTier1Indicator().
  - [Tier 1: Manual Schema](https://percept.one/docs/features/indicators/tier1-schema.md): Full-control indicator definitions with IIndicatorSchema.
  - [Tier 2: Advanced Control](https://percept.one/docs/features/indicators/tier2-advanced.md): Build indicators with external data and live streaming.
    - [Example: Open Interest](https://percept.one/docs/features/indicators/example-open-interest.md): Complete example of a Tier 2 indicator with live data streaming.
    - [Volume Profile Guide](https://percept.one/docs/features/indicators/volume-profile-guide.md): Volume profile indicator family — data format, engine settings, and building custom variants.
    - [Heatmap Guide](https://percept.one/docs/features/indicators/heatmap-guide.md): Heatmap indicators — orderbook heatmap, Hyperliquid liquidation heatmap, TP/SL heatmap, data pipeline, settings, sensitivity calibration, and building custom heatmaps.
    - [TPO / Market Profile Guide](https://percept.one/docs/features/indicators/tpo-guide.md): TPO / Market Profile indicator — session types, trading hours, period management, and context menu integration.
    - [Compare / Arbitrage Guide](https://percept.one/docs/features/indicators/compare-guide.md): Cross-exchange comparison — Ghost Line overlay, Price Spread subchart, syncGroup linking, ArbitrageButton, smart exchange defaults, and $spline color tokens.
    - [Multi-Symbol Guide](https://percept.one/docs/features/indicators/multi-symbol-guide.md): Build indicators that compare data across multiple exchanges and symbols.
  - [Tier 3: Worker-Parsed](https://percept.one/docs/features/indicators/tier3-builder.md): Build worker-parsed indicators with automatic data fetching.
  - [Calculation Helpers](https://percept.one/docs/features/indicators/calc-helpers.md): Pure math utilities for indicator calculations.
  - [Data Fetching Guide](https://percept.one/docs/features/indicators/data-fetching.md): Understanding data fetching architecture for Tier 2 indicators
  - [Placement](https://percept.one/docs/features/indicators/placement.md): Understand onchart vs offchart indicator placement.
  - [API Reference](https://percept.one/docs/features/indicators/api-reference.md): Chart and Registry API methods for indicator management.
  - [Common Pitfalls](https://percept.one/docs/features/indicators/pitfalls.md): Avoid common mistakes when building indicators.
- [Drawing Tools](https://percept.one/docs/features/drawing-tools.md): Create, edit, and persist user drawings.
- [Keyboard Shortcuts](https://percept.one/docs/features/keyboard-shortcuts.md): Rebindable chart hotkeys with a built-in editor dialog — drawing tools, viewport navigation, quick interval switching, and client-defined custom shortcuts.
- [Copy, Paste & Undo](https://percept.one/docs/features/copy-paste.md): Copy, cut, and paste drawings (across charts and tabs via the OS clipboard), paste foreign text and images, bulk-delete a selection, and a content-scoped undo/redo history.
- [Dialogs](https://percept.one/docs/features/dialogs/README.md): Schema-driven dialog system for settings panels and list pickers.
  - [Built-In Dialogs](https://percept.one/docs/features/dialogs/built-in-dialogs.md): Pre-configured indicator and symbol picker dialogs, enabled by default.
  - [Form Dialogs](https://percept.one/docs/features/dialogs/form-dialogs.md): Build settings dialogs with single-form or sidebar-section layouts.
  - [Picker Dialogs](https://percept.one/docs/features/dialogs/picker-dialogs.md): Build list-selection dialogs with search, categories, and keyboard navigation.
  - [Input Types](https://percept.one/docs/features/dialogs/input-types.md): Reference for the built-in input types (number, text, boolean, select, color, slider, etc.) available in form dialogs.
  - [Schema Reference](https://percept.one/docs/features/dialogs/schema-reference.md): Complete type reference for dialog schema definitions.
  - [Hooks Reference](https://percept.one/docs/features/dialogs/hooks-reference.md): React hooks (useDialog, etc.) for managing dialog state and navigation.
  - [Responsive Design](https://percept.one/docs/features/dialogs/responsive-design.md): Container-responsive dialog system for compact / mobile shells.
  - [Styling](https://percept.one/docs/features/dialogs/styling.md): Customize dialog appearance with CSS imports, CSS variables, and class overrides.
  - [Advanced Usage](https://percept.one/docs/features/dialogs/advanced-usage.md): Schema generators, conditional helpers, picker list states, and lower-level dialog components.
  - [Examples](https://percept.one/docs/features/dialogs/examples.md): Real-world dialog patterns including indicator settings and symbol pickers.
- [Data Polling](https://percept.one/docs/features/data-polling.md): Periodic gap recovery for live charts.
- [Empty States](https://percept.one/docs/features/empty-states.md): Automatic "No data here" overlays for empty chart panes.
- [Interval Changes](https://percept.one/docs/features/interval-change.md): Handle interval changes with automatic data refetching.
- [Context Changes (Symbol/Exchange)](https://percept.one/docs/features/context-changes.md): Handle market (symbol/exchange) changes with automatic data refetching.
- [Viewport Clamping](https://percept.one/docs/features/clamping.md): Restrict pan and zoom to a fixed time/price window without locking out programmatic resets.
- [Shell Layout](https://percept.one/docs/features/shell/README.md): Add header, toolbar, and footer around your chart canvas.
  - [Layout Configuration](https://percept.one/docs/features/shell/layout.md): Control which shell parts are visible with granular precision.
  - [Slots](https://percept.one/docs/features/shell/slots.md): Inject custom components into shell areas.
  - [Styling](https://percept.one/docs/features/shell/styling.md): Customize shell appearance with CSS classes and variables.
- [Theming & Customization](https://percept.one/docs/features/theming.md): Control theme, visuals, layout, and localization.
- [Chart Features](https://percept.one/docs/features/chart-features.md): Built-in chart UX features — navigation overlay, right-click context menus, reference lines, session breaks, and price-axis formats, all on by default.
- [Caching & Warm Loading](https://percept.one/docs/features/caching.md): How TitanCharts caches market data for instant loads — what's cached, freshness, configuration, opting out, and the rules for custom data feeds and indicators.
- [Typography](https://percept.one/docs/features/typography.md): Font families, sizes, weights, and per-surface text styling in TitanCharts.
- [Annotations](https://percept.one/docs/features/annotations.md): Declarative data markers for labeling chart events, signals, and price levels.
- [Reference Lines](https://percept.one/docs/features/references.md): Declarative horizontal price-level lines (interactive when opted in) for any chart context.
- [Polymarket Integration](https://percept.one/docs/features/polymarket.md): Add Polymarket prediction market charting to your app with a single platform plugin.
- [Hyperliquid Portfolio Overlay](https://percept.one/docs/features/hyperliquid.md): Drop-in read-only overlay of any Hyperliquid wallet's full trading activity directly on the chart.
- [Licensing](https://percept.one/docs/features/licensing.md): License key requirement, premium feature gating, and how to obtain a key.

## Trading

- [Overview](https://percept.one/docs/trading/README.md): Manage positions, orders, and trade markers on the chart.
- [Quick Examples](https://percept.one/docs/quick-examples.md): Copy-paste snippets with visual outcomes to get started fast.
- [Data Models](https://percept.one/docs/trading/data-models.md): Data interfaces for positions, orders, trades, and type aliases.
- [API Methods](https://percept.one/docs/trading/api-methods.md): All trading API methods with signatures and examples.
- [Events](https://percept.one/docs/trading/events.md): Trading events emitted by chart interactions.
- [Patterns & Examples](https://percept.one/docs/trading/patterns.md): Real-world integration patterns and a working example.
- [Customizing Drafts](https://percept.one/docs/trading/customizing-drafts.md): Customize the draft-order popovers — chips, max-size cap, custom order types, or full-custom UI.
- [Visual Reference](https://percept.one/docs/trading/visual-reference.md): Colors, marker variants, and common pitfalls.

## DataFeed API

- [Overview](https://percept.one/docs/datafeed-api/README.md): Managed vs manual data strategies for TitanChart.
- [IDataFeed Interface Reference](https://percept.one/docs/datafeed-api/interface-reference.md): Complete method-by-method reference for the IDataFeed interface.
- [Building a Custom DataFeed](https://percept.one/docs/datafeed-api/custom-datafeed.md): Build a custom IDataFeed for any data source.
- [Feed Injection & Discovery](https://percept.one/docs/datafeed-api/feed-injection.md): One DataFeed, two surfaces — share it with the chart and your own UI.
- [TitanCharts DataFeed](https://percept.one/docs/datafeed-api/titancharts-datafeed/README.md): Get live charts running with managed data in under a minute.
  - [Authentication](https://percept.one/docs/datafeed-api/titancharts-datafeed/authentication.md): Two authentication modes — direct and auth proxy.
  - [Configuration](https://percept.one/docs/datafeed-api/titancharts-datafeed/configuration.md): Full DataFeedConfig reference, events, and error handling.

- [Events](https://percept.one/docs/api-reference/events.md): Handle user interaction, viewport changes, and lifecycle events.
- [Types](https://percept.one/docs/api-reference/types.md): Complete TypeScript types reference for Percept.
- [Constants](https://percept.one/docs/api-reference/constants.md): Exported constants for data types, intervals, and timezones.
- [Glossary](https://percept.one/docs/glossary.md): Key TitanCharts concepts, cross-linked — DataFeed, indicator tiers, overlays, viewport, and more.
